lua: T = require('lib.testkit'); CAM = require('lib.camera'); AT = function(x, z, face) local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.x, p.z, p.face = x, z, face; p.walk_to, p.walk_path = nil, nil; CAM.reset(face) end

route.lua: local d = nova.named('door_hazel'); local c = nova.named('cabin_hazel'); local a = math.atan(d.x - c.x, d.z - c.z); AT(d.x + math.sin(a) * 1.4, d.z + math.cos(a) * 1.4, a)

route.lua: local h, v, s = nova.named('hazel'), nova.named('van'), nova.scene_now(); v:teleport(h.meet[1], h.meet[2] + 3.4, 0); local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.x, p.z = s:van_point(s.BACK); p.face = math.pi; require('lib.state').carrying = 'pip'; CAM.reset(math.pi)

route.lua: require('lib.state').van_load = {}; local h, p = nova.named('hazel'), nova.named('postmaster'); p.x, p.z = h.x + 1.3, h.z; p.face = math.atan(h.x - p.x, h.z - p.z); CAM.reset(p.face)
